title: Resolution urging Congress to add warning labels to food
summary: This resolution calls on the US Congress to pass and the President to sign legislation requiring nutrition labels on food and drink products to include consumer education markings such as warning symbols. It cites examples like Chile's mandatory warning labels and the UK's traffic-light labeling system as models. It notes that 26.8% of New York City residents and 37.4% of Bronx residents have a body mass index of 30 or higher.
